name: Witch Doctor Soul Marionette explosions leave the enemy stunned
contract: Soul Marionette 704497: the five clones explode at the 20th stack, 'stunning enemies within $706553a1 yds'.
All five explosions 706553 (Effect[1] MOD_STUN, 4000 ms, 5 yd) hit the same enemy in the same instant;
each later stun climbed the stun diminishing returns (DRTYPE_ALL) and the zero-duration result removed the
aura, so in both final05 runs the dummy was not stunned (cycle 8 R5, M-51). The fix (Necromancer ADR 0050
precedent) strips the stun effect from an explosion on an enemy that already holds 706553: one explosion
stuns, the others deal damage only. The clones tick every 2000 ms, so the 20th stack and the explosions
come about 8000 ms after the cast. Expected: the dummy 3 yd away holds 706553 and is stunned, still 1.5 s
later; a dummy 12 yd away, beyond the clone ring plus 5 yd, is not.
